run_hatexplain_preprocessing: run the HatExplain dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_hatexplain_dataset: create a HatExplain classification dataset instance with hatespeech, normal, and offensive labels
load_hatexplain_hf_dataset: load the hatexplain HuggingFace dataset using the load_dataset method
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of post tokens and majority-voted labels
generate_k_shot_data: generate 16-shot train, dev, and test splits from the HatExplain dataset with a given seed
